page_contract: The reader should understand that most sampled simile nouns are generalists, while a smaller right-tail is highly predictable, because horizontal position shows Simpson concentration and circle size shows corpus occurrences for every retained noun.

author_layer.counting_method: UTF-8 decoded characters in author-written runtime files

after.assessment: The original was already compact but not learnable: nearly all CSS and JavaScript lived on two 2.5k/4.2k lines. The candidate deliberately spends 3,184 characters on semantic file boundaries, names, indentation, deterministic fallback and lifecycle cleanup. At 12,020 author characters it remains a small full sample, but it still needs a separate quality-preserving mini if selected as an auxiliary sample.

excluded.pages/data/simpson.js: data-only local-file wrapper around the canonical CSV

changes: Split the five-line monolith into semantic HTML, rule-per-line compact CSS and readable-compact chart JavaScript.
Restored descriptive names and visible modules for parsing, deterministic dodge layout, SVG construction, tooltip placement, selection/reset and teardown.
Kept canonical parsed records outside rendering and passes a shallow derived copy into the mutating layout stage.
Kept the real square-root radius and deterministic tangent-candidate dodge algorithm; no coordinates, radii, labels or results are precomputed.
Added one AbortController-owned listener lifecycle, pagehide disposal and Deck resize cleanup without adding a loop, simulation or replacement renderer.
Kept keyboard focus from overwriting a pinned datum, so visible tooltip, aria-current and retained inspection state remain synchronized.
Made a missing shared chassis script select the same evidence-rich textual fallback already used for data or renderer failure.
Preserved every noun, visible mark, direct label, tick, legend, annotation, tooltip field, fallback statement and fixed copy.

data_and_encoding.uncertainty_note: No uncertainty intervals are supplied by the upstream aggregate; the page identifies the values as corpus aggregates rather than population estimates.

layout_equivalence.deterministic_order: descending totalCount, stable CSV order for ties

pixel_comparison.method: paired fresh Chromium RGB screenshots after fonts.ready at fixed DOM states
pixel_comparison.assessment: All DOM, data, geometry, text, attributes and state hashes are exactly equal. The two tiny nonzero raster pairs are SVG text/stroke antialias resampling after focus invalidation; initial, reduced, focus, 1600 pinned and fallback frames are RGB AE=0.

tests.name: canonical records, units, domains and evidence
tests.evidence: Independent CSV parsing reproduced 101 retained nouns, [0,1] score domain, extrema, 75 below 50%, the 13-noun 20–25% bin and exact tooltip units.

tests.name: real deterministic layout
tests.evidence: Every x and radius matched its source field and formula; every relevant pair met the 3px tangent separation; formal/candidate layout SHA is equal.

tests.name: keyboard, mouse and touch
tests.evidence: Tab focus, Enter/Space pin, Escape reset, pointer hover/move/leave, click and touchscreen tap expose the same noun evidence. A pinned datum now remains canonical while focus traverses until Enter/Space explicitly transfers or clears the pin. Pointer cancellation has no retained gesture state.

tests.name: selection and double reset
tests.evidence: Pinned aria-current and tooltip state clear twice without changing node order, layout, radii or labels.

tests.name: reduced motion
tests.evidence: The deterministic chart has no force simulation or authored animation; reduced motion preserves the same complete 101-mark evidence and disables tooltip transition.

tests.name: resize
tests.evidence: Live 1600x900 to 1280x720 resize preserves the 1568x720 logical SVG and all layout coordinates while the chassis scales to a document with exactly 1280x720 scroll dimensions.

tests.name: renderer/data failure fallback
tests.evidence: Aborting simpson.js reveals matching fallback innerText and an RGB AE=0 frame containing units, extrema, count maximum and below-50 result. Aborting the shared chassis script now selects the same evidence-rich fallback without a page exception.

tests.name: pagehide disposal and reload
tests.evidence: pagehide aborts all owned node/window listeners and unsubscribes Deck resize; post-dispose focus/click/Enter are inert; reload rebuilds exactly 101 nodes with no retained selection.

tests.name: selfcheck and runtime
tests.evidence: JavaScript syntax and the original selfcheck pass with zero JS errors, failed resources, clipping, escaping, overlap, intrusion or undersized text; normal browser runs have no console/page/request errors.

rejected_optimizations: Do not restore the original 4.2k single JavaScript line or cryptic one-letter business identifiers merely to regain the 8.8k total.
Do not encode canonical rows, final coordinates, tangent candidates, labels or tooltip lists as opaque positional arrays.
Do not remove small nouns, direct labels, the fixed [0,1] domain, ticks, legend, source evidence, keyboard focus, touch activation or fallback copy.
Do not replace the deterministic dodge with random jitter, a baked SVG, screenshot, canvas or perpetual force simulation.
remaining_risks: Two post-focus SVG raster pairs contain at most 59 subpixel antialias differences despite exact DOM/state hashes.
The staging candidate references formal data and chassis through relative symlinks; promotion must preserve or materialize them deliberately.

revisions: Pinned keyboard state was internally stale: focusing a second noun changed the tooltip and aria-current but left the old datum in pinned, causing later hover to be locked by a different selection. Focus now previews only when no pin is active; Enter or Space explicitly transfers/toggles the pin.

Aborting base.js previously threw before the chart try/catch and left the .js-only fallback hidden. The candidate now removes the .js gate and returns immediately when Deck is unavailable, preserving the same textual quantitative evidence used for data failure.
cross_audit.readability: Readable-compact: canonical parsing, formulas, deterministic dodge, SVG construction, tooltip state and lifecycle have descriptive names and bounded functions. The 292-character maximum is the complete accessible figure summary; the longest JavaScript line is the exact tooltip evidence template. No cryptic business-state abbreviations or commentary inflation remain.
cross_audit.algorithm_and_data_integrity: All 101 retained records still come from the canonical CSV wrapper. Score x positions, square-root radii and every 3px non-overlap placement are computed at runtime; no records, coordinates, tangent candidates or layout outputs were baked into the candidate.

independent_evidence.encoding: 101 CSV records; x = 54 + 1455 * score; r = 8 + 40 * sqrt(count/2880); every pair retains 3px tangent separation
independent_evidence.fallback: both simpson.js failure and base.js failure preserve 0–100% meaning, 2,880 count maximum, 4.23%/92.45% extrema and 75-of-101 conclusion
independent_evidence.lifecycle: the chart owns zero RAF loops; pagehide reduced its resize owner from 1 to 0, aborted all handlers, left post-dispose focus/click/Enter inert, and reload restored one SVG with 101 nodes
independent_evidence.selfcheck: Initial and reset states have no clipping, escaping, overlap, intrusion, tiny text, runtime error or failed request. The tooltip-state overlap heuristic reports text inside the tooltip/nearby marks, but direct browser geometry and screenshots show no clipped evidence.

cross_audit.public_api: not applicable; the sample exposes no mutable public API. Cached DOM references were exercised after pagehide and their owned handlers were inert.
cross_audit.symlink_and_http: Candidate data and shared chassis links resolve to the unchanged formal files and normal resources serve successfully over HTTP.
cross_audit.remaining_risk: Two saved post-focus raster pairs retain the previously documented subpixel SVG antialias differences despite exact DOM and layout state; fresh fixed pairs in this audit were byte-exact.
